name: Glow of Honeydew
source:
Tels has been living with her roommate Kit for quite some time, longer than any roommates she'd had thus far. Most people can't handle a weird girl who refuses to leave her house, but Kit doesn't seem to mind. There's even other bonuses to living with a girl like Kit, like listening to the cute noises she makes in her room.

For a fun personal project, Tels begins to snoop on the internet traffic in the house, only to discover there is a lot she doesn't know about Kit at all. 

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4708300/Glow_of_Honeydew/]Steam[/url]]
